title: First-run billing banners & deprecation toasts — localized quickstart screenshots for model catalog release
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Objective: Produce a set of first-time-user (FTU) UX assets for the model catalog release that surface contextual billing information, gently warn about deprecated models via toasts, and provide localized quickstart screenshots for release notes and docs.
Scope:
- Static screenshots for release notes (desktop + mobile) showing: new model card with first-run billing banner; model detail page with cost breakdown popover; a deprecation toast pattern (dismissible) for sunsetted models.
- Variants for three locales (en-US, fr-FR, ja-JP) and two color themes (light/dark).
- Exported assets and a Figma handoff package with redlines and tokens.
Deliverables:
1) Release-note hero screenshot (desktop) with billing banner callout
2) Compact catalog tile (mobile + desktop) with price pill and tier tooltip
3) Deprecation toast family (info/warning/critical) and animation spec
4) Model detail cost breakdown modal mock
5) Localized overlays and copy CSV
6) Figma file + export slices + handoff notes
Acceptance criteria:
- Assets match Redwood brand tokens and console spacing system
- Copy mirrors PM-approved strings (file: attachments/Copy_MASTER_v2.xlsx)
- All images exported at required @1x/@2x sizes and named per handoff convention
- Color contrast meets WCAG AA for text and 3:1 for UI components where applicable
- Implementation hooks documented (ENG tickets referenced in dependencies)
Implementation notes:
- Use compact catalog card for mobile widths <= 480px, expanded for >= 1024px
- Billing banner should be a single-line summary with a chevron that opens the cost breakdown modal
- Deprecation toasts include an action: "View replacement" and a learn-more link to the model lifecycle doc
- Animations: 150ms ease-out for toast entrance, 250ms for modal overlay fade
- Localization: allocate extra vertical space for ja-JP and fr-FR copy, use fallback token for currency formatting (engine will localize amounts)
